upstream.reference: SM8450-HDK.m4: WCD RX0/TX3, 48 kHz S16_LE playback/capture. Only those board endpoints are selected.

wrsh_port.reason: Static WR shared-memory output port is 1; the kernel omits connection entries with source output port 0. A local m4 file supplies port 1 without modifying the pinned upstream source.

scope: Unicorn WCD RX0/TX3 at 48 kHz and tertiary TDM playback at 96 kHz, three channels. The named stereo PCM maps L/R and keeps transport channel 3 zero. Amplifier firmware, calibration and Music data are private runtime inputs, prepared separately. Hardware acceptance is recorded in docs/unicorn/README.md.

mbhc_defaults.scope: def_wcd_mbhc_cal button thresholds 75/260/500/500/500/500/500/500 mV. NC types and VA DMIC sample rate are in the pinned board/overlay references.
